title: Modernizing Compiler Design for Carbon Toolchain - Chandler Carruth - CppNow 2023
summary: Chandler Carruth's CppNow 2023 talk on modernizing compiler design for the Carbon toolchain, using data-oriented design and modern hardware assumptions. It covers lexing, parsing and compact data structures aimed at compiler performance.
why: Recommended as a recent take on rethinking compiler architecture, and cited in discussions of flattened ASTs and fast lexers.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I recommend a watch of this for a recent take on trying to change how we think of these.
